desc: Implement the LCS-row transition for appending one lowercase character, using the fixed string S.
Build the layered hashmap DP over distinct LCS rows for all M positions, processing all 26 letters and merging duplicate successor rows.
Aggregate final row counts by the last entry to obtain exact-LCS counts for every k=0..N.
Apply modulo 998244353 throughout and output the required space-separated distribution.
Check edge cases including repeated characters, M=1, absent letters, and zero-count LCS values.
